description: UI concepts only; data shown in generated images is illustrative. Runtime UI uses server data.
course:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a single exceptionally polished desktop web application screen for the Chinese teacher-training product 临客 LINK. Landscape 1600x1000 framing, straight-on screen, no device frame, no presentation annotations. This is the refined COURSE CENTER UI design. Reference image 1 is the earlier approved desk concept, preserve its immersive warm real 3D desktop character and paper-cut headline, but REDUCE all copy and visual clutter strongly. Reference image 2 supplies character style only.
Shared design language: quiet deep aubergine sidebar and upper UI, warm cream paper, desaturated lavender, apricot orange CTA, rounded finely modeled tangible objects, realistic soft contact shadows, restrained warm wood scene, generous whitespace. Modern Chinese sans-serif body, large playful layered cream-and-purple cut-paper title. No glass-card grid, no slogans, no introductory paragraph, no callout arrows, no English labels, no design annotations. Keep UI immediately usable.
Left sidebar width 160 with exact compact items "临客 LINK", "工作台", "课程中心" (selected), "教学训练", "AI 评课", "成长档案", "资源库", "知识库". Small profile/settings bottom.
Main top: oversized dimensional paper headline exactly "我的备课桌", right compact search "搜索课程" and button "全部课程".
Main content is ONE beautiful asymmetrically arranged warm open prep desk, no separate boxes: envelope 导入, miniature chalkboard 板书, lavender projector 演示, open book 讲解, prompt cards 提问, wooden stamp 强化, brass bell 结束, clipboard 组织, pastel paper fan 变化, central ring-bound planner 综合. Put each SHORT category label beside its object only once, typeset cleanly. Book selected with subtle warm edge, not neon. Detailed tactile paper grain and bookcloth. Objects sufficiently separated for clicking, all ten visible.
Bottom ONE horizontal dark-purple detail ribbon containing ONLY "讲解技能", a small progress "3 / 8 课时", thin progress bar, secondary "详情", orange primary "开始训练 ↗". Remove descriptive sentence and duplicate bottom skill strip from reference. Tiny unified polished lavender suit chibi headset assistant lower right, not obstructing CTA, no speech bubble. No other text. Highly crafted finished UI presentation, crisp legible Chinese.
